name: RTI-177
summary: RTI(-4229)-177 (2β-(3-phenylisoxazol-5-yl)-3β-(4-chlorophenyl)tropane, β-CPPIT) is a synthetic stimulant drug from the phenyltropane family, which acts as a DRI with micromolar affinity for the SERT. RTI-177 has an unusually long duration of action of 20 hours or more, substantially longer than the related compound RTI-336 from which it differs in molecular structure only by the absence of a p-methyl group.

pharmacology.text: RTI(-4229)-177 (2β-(3-phenylisoxazol-5-yl)-3β-(4-chlorophenyl)tropane, β-CPPIT) is a synthetic stimulant drug from the phenyltropane family, which acts as a DRI with micromolar affinity for the SERT.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: RTI-177 enters the brain slowly and leaves slowly. Researchers study such slow-acting dopamine blockers because a gentle rise in dopamine seems much less reinforcing than a sudden one.
fact.zh: RTI-177 進入和離開大腦的速度都很慢。研究人員研究這類作用緩慢的多巴胺阻斷劑，因為多巴胺緩慢上升的成癮強化作用似乎遠低於驟然上升。
fact.zhHans: RTI-177 进入和离开大脑的速度都很慢。研究人员研究这类作用缓慢的多巴胺阻断剂，因为多巴胺缓慢上升的成瘾强化作用似乎远低于骤然上升。
